components.promise: The scenario specification: templates, documents, assertions, and the lifecycle that turns a template into trigger evidence
The contract schemas for every document on the wire, and the Python validator that enforces them strictly
The command line interface with stable exit codes and portable JSON reports
The local fixture runner that executes paired baseline and treatment variants
Reference fixture environments with install, digest, and release semantics
The synthetic scenario pack: all 24 fault templates with assertions and cleanup
The fault adapter interface, the reference adapter, and the conformance suite third parties must pass
The append-only evidence chain with source trust labels, and its schemas
Comparison, cost accounting, and the fixed-cohort assurance statistics with their property tests
The basic local UI with inert evidence rendering
The effect broker with bounded delegation and the evidence fence, the governor with grant expiry and the emergency stop, and the supervising reviewer with degradation
